while r < len

...
s[w++] = s[r++];

Bug: s is char*, but isxdigit expects unsigned char or EOF. With signed char, negative values cause out-of-bounds table index. So isxdigit(s[r+1]) uses signed char negative -> UB.

Also s[w++] writes in place, w may exceed? r increments, w increments same? For % case, w increments 1, r increments 3, so w <= r? Might be okay but in-place decode shrinks, so w <= r always. So no overflow.
